168: async function resolveDeckKeyMetadata(
169:   lemmaKeys: readonly string[],
170:   lexemes: readonly PracticeLexeme[],
171:   cache: Map<string, Promise<unknown>>,
172: ): Promise<Map<string, DeckKeyResolution>> {
173:   const practiceByKey = practiceLexemesByKey(lexemes);
174:   const resolutions = new Map<string, DeckKeyResolution>();
175:   const unresolved: string[] = [];
176: 
177:   for (const key of lemmaKeys) {
178:     const practice = keyLookupVariants(key)
179:       .map((variant) => practiceByKey.get(variant))
180:       .find((entry): entry is PracticeLexeme => Boolean(entry)) ?? null;
181:     resolutions.set(key, { practice, atlas: null });
182:     if (!practice) unresolved.push(key);
183:   }
184: 
185:   // The common case is a deck entirely covered by the practice cores. Do not
186:   // download any Atlas index artifact in that case.
187:   if (unresolved.length === 0) return resolutions;
188: 
189:   let rows: SearchRow[] = [];
190:   let needsFullIndexFallback = false;
191:   try {
192:     const manifest = await getShardJson<SearchShardManifest>('/lexicon/search-shards.json', cache);
193:     const shardPaths = Array.from(
194:       new Set(
195:         unresolved.flatMap((key) =>
196:           keyLookupVariants(key)
197:             .map((variant) => searchShardForQuery(manifest, variant)?.path)
198:             .filter((path): path is string => Boolean(path)),
199:         ),

201:     );
202:     if (shardPaths.length === 0) {
203:       needsFullIndexFallback = true;
204:     } else {
205:       rows = (await Promise.all(
206:         shardPaths.map((path) => getShardJson<SearchRow[]>(path, cache)),
207:       )).flat();
208:       const shardRowsByKey = searchRowsByKey(rows);
209:       needsFullIndexFallback = unresolved.some(
210:         (key) => !keyLookupVariants(key).some((variant) => shardRowsByKey.has(variant)),
211:       );
212:     }
213:   } catch {
214:     needsFullIndexFallback = true;
215:   }

217:   if (needsFullIndexFallback) {
218:     // Last resort only: older/static deployments can lack a manifest or a
219:     // relevant shard even though their legacy complete index still has the row.
220:     rows = await getShardJson<SearchRow[]>('/lexicon/search-index.json', cache).catch(() => []);
221:   }

223:   const atlasByKey = searchRowsByKey(rows);
224:   for (const key of unresolved) {

226:       .map((variant) => atlasByKey.get(variant))
227:       .find((entry): entry is SearchRow => Boolean(entry));

229:     const gloss = atlasRow.g ? cleanGloss(atlasRow.g) : '';
230:     resolutions.set(key, {

232:       atlas: {
233:         lemma: atlasRow.l,
234:         slug: atlasRow.s,

236:         // same concise first-sense labels eligible for practice cards.
237:         gloss: isPhraseGloss(gloss) ? null : gloss,
238:         cefr: atlasRow.c ?? null,

469:     const genderName = parts.find(p => p !== 'рід' && CASE_GLOSSES[p]);
470:     const genderEn = genderName ? CASE_GLOSSES[genderName] : '';
471:     const otherParts = parts.filter(p => p !== 'рід' && p !== genderName).map(p => CASE_GLOSSES[p] || p);
472:     if (genderEn) {
473:       const genderStr = `${genderEn} gender`;
474:       return otherParts.length > 0 ? `${genderStr}, ${otherParts.join(', ')}` : genderStr;
475:     }
476:   }
477: 
478:   const translatedParts = parts.map(part => {
479:     if (CASE_GLOSSES[part]) return CASE_GLOSSES[part];
480:     for (const [uk, en] of Object.entries(CASE_GLOSSES)) {
481:       if (part.includes(uk)) return en;
482:     }
483:     return part;
484:   });
485: 
486:   return translatedParts.join(', ');

778: export function isEnglishLearnerGloss(label: string): boolean {
779:   const clean = label.trim();
780:   if (!clean) return false;
781:   const latinLetters = clean.match(/\p{Script=Latin}/gu)?.length ?? 0;
782:   const cyrillicLetters = clean.match(/\p{Script=Cyrillic}/gu)?.length ?? 0;
783:   return latinLetters > cyrillicLetters;
784: }

791:   return feedback ? usablePracticeSentenceEnglish(raw) : null;
792: }

794: function isPhraseGloss(label: string): boolean {
795:   const clean = label.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
796:   // Count alphanumeric tokens (ignoring standalone punctuation) to match the
797:   // Python deck generator's `_meaning_label_word_count` regex exactly, so the
798:   // served deck and this runtime guard never disagree on eligibility.
799:   const wordCount = clean ? (clean.match(/[^\W_]+(?:[-'][^\W_]+)?/gu) || []).length : 0;
800:   return (
801:     !clean ||
802:     clean.length > MEANING_MC_MAX_CHARS ||
803:     wordCount > MEANING_MC_MAX_WORDS ||
804:     clean.includes('?') ||
805:     clean.includes('(') ||
806:     clean.includes(')')
807:   );
808: }

810: export function isMeaningMcEligible(entry: PracticeLexeme): boolean {
811:   const label = glossLabel(entry);
812:   if (entry.meaningMcEligible === false) return false;
813:   // Judge the CLEAN first-sense label, not the raw multi-sense gloss: a word like
814:   // "dog; hound" has a perfectly concise glossClean ("dog") and must stay eligible.
815:   if (!isEnglishLearnerGloss(label)) return false;
816:   if (isPhraseGloss(label)) return false;
817:   if (FUNCTION_GLOSS_HEADWORDS.has(glossHeadword(entry))) return false;
818:   if (entry.pos && FUNCTION_POS.has(entry.pos.toLocaleLowerCase('en-US'))) return false;
819:   return entry.meaningMcEligible ?? true;
820: }

841: function readDailyReRollCount(dateKey: string): number {

888: function recordStreak(date = new Date()): StreakState {
889:   const current = readStreak();
890:   const today = todayKey(date);
891:   if (current.lastPracticeDate === today) return current;
892:   const nextCount = current.lastPracticeDate === previousDayKey(date) ? current.current + 1 : 1;
893:   const next = { version: 1 as const, current: nextCount, lastPracticeDate: today };
894:   writeStreak(next);
895:   return next;

945: export function addDailyExamples(
946:   lexemes: Map<string, PracticeLexeme>,
947:   clozeItems: readonly PracticeClozeItem[],
948: ): Map<string, PracticeLexeme> {
949:   const fallbackByLemma = new Map<string, { example: string; exampleEn: string | null }>();
950:   for (const item of clozeItems) {
951:     if (fallbackByLemma.has(item.lemmaId)) continue;
952:     const example = clozeExample(item);
953:     if (example) fallbackByLemma.set(item.lemmaId, example);
954:   }
955: 
956:   const enriched = new Map<string, PracticeLexeme>();
957:   for (const [lemmaId, lexeme] of lexemes) {
958:     if (lexeme.example?.trim()) {
959:       enriched.set(lemmaId, lexeme);
960:       continue;
961:     }
962:     const fallback = fallbackByLemma.get(lemmaId);
963:     enriched.set(
964:       lemmaId,
965:       fallback
966:         ? { ...lexeme, example: fallback.example, exampleEn: lexeme.exampleEn ?? fallback.exampleEn }
967:         : lexeme,
968:     );
969:   }
970:   return enriched;
971: }

986: function normalizeInitialDeck(initialDeck?: PracticeDeckData | PracticeLexeme[]): PracticeDeckData | null {
987:   if (!initialDeck) return null;
988:   if (!Array.isArray(initialDeck)) return initialDeck;
989:   const lexemes = initialDeck.map((entry) => {
990:     const legacy = entry as PracticeLexeme & { slug?: string; example?: string | null };
991:     const lemmaId = legacy.lemmaId ?? legacy.slug ?? legacy.lemma;
992:     const glossClean = legacy.glossClean ?? cleanGloss(legacy.gloss);
993:     const meaningMcEligible = legacy.meaningMcEligible ?? (
994:       isEnglishLearnerGloss(glossClean) && !isPhraseGloss(glossClean)
995:     );
996:     return {
997:       ...entry,
998:       lemmaId,
999:       lemmaPlain: legacy.lemmaPlain ?? czNorm(legacy.lemma),
1000:       glossClean,
1001:       meaningMcEligible,
1002:       severity: legacy.severity ?? null,
1003:       paradigm: legacy.paradigm ?? { cases: {} },
1004:     };
1005:   });
1006:   const deckGuidanceLevel = lexemes.find((entry) => entry.cefr)?.cefr ?? 'unknown';
1007:   return {
1008:     deckVersion: 'test-fixture',

1102:       isMeaningMcEligible(candidate) &&

1110:   const rings = new Map<number, PracticeLexeme[]>();

1126:         const rightPos = right.pos === answer.pos ? 0 : 1;
1127:         if (leftPos !== rightPos) return leftPos - rightPos;

1129:         const rightLen = Math.abs(glossLabel(right).length - answerLength);
1130:         return leftLen - rightLen || left.lemmaId.localeCompare(right.lemmaId);

1136:         return true;

commit 2309379de844301e44cdc1a4ebd37d24e2aa91c9
Author: krisztiankoos <48318836+krisztiankoos@users.noreply.github.com>

    fix(practice): learner layout P0 fixes for non-power-user affordances (#6336)
    
    * fix(practice): learner layout P0 fixes for non-power-user affordances
    
    Implements the K3 P0 list (docs/practice/learner-layout-ux-p0.md) plus the
    Opus critique items that were still live in code (learner-layout-ux-opus.md):
    
    - P0-1: mode descriptions now render on every card, not only the shared
      hover line (touch learners never saw them before).
    - P0-2: every active-phase empty state (no cards, cloze/heritage/paronym
      preparing, all-caught-up, empty matching/choice pools) gets a real
      primary next-action button plus honest-count secondary mode buttons
      instead of a text-only dead end.
    - P0-3: zero-count mode cards are now `disabled` (not just dimmed) and
      show an explicit "no exercises yet" state; the count badge is no longer
      aria-hidden. Also fixes the Opus P0-2 root cause: unmatched custom-deck
      keys no longer claim the full 8-mode list, only flashcards(+cloze).
    - P0-4: heritage renders as a text chip on the flashcard back (native/
      inherited/borrowed/calque/avoid), color stays secondary.
    - P0-5: stress vowel targets raised to >=48px with visible digit badges
      and Digit-1..n accelerators.
    - P0-6: flashcards get a visible flip hint and a "flip first" rating
      hint, interval previews get a locale-aware prefix, digit hints get
      aria-labels. Also fixes Opus P0-5: rating colors used to exist only on
      :hover, so touch/at-rest showed four identical grey buttons.
    - P0-7: daily-deck collapsed counters are glyph + number + label, not
      bare colored numbers.
    - P0-8: secondary controls (weak chips, switch-offer actions, daily
      reroll, and the shared button floor) raised to >=48px.
    - Opus P0-1: Drive sync + deck management no longer render above the
      dashboard (out of scope, risked the HARD-1/HARD-2 fold gates) — folded
      behind a closed-by-default disclosure below the mode grid.
    - Opus P0-6: a cloze case-miss no longer loops forever — it's capped at
      two attempts, then locks and reveals via the existing PracticeFormRail;
      the typed value is selected instead of cleared.
    - Opus P0-7: the Due stat tile now shares the same daily-snapshot basis
